name: C*Core Technology Co., Ltd.
blurb: C*Core Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese semiconductor company specializing in the design and development of embedded CPU cores and related system-on-chip (SoC) solutions. The company's products are used in various applications including IoT, smart home, and industrial control. It holds a notable position in China's domestic semiconductor IP market, competing with international players.
